name: Load Data File
description: Read a problem's data file with problem_manager, with a list of the built-in loaders
code:
# problem_manager is available in every solution. Built-in loaders:
#   problem_manager.load_words_data()      words.txt     -> list of words
#   problem_manager.load_names_data()      names.txt     -> list of names
#   problem_manager.load_matrix_data()     matrix.txt    -> list of rows of ints
#   problem_manager.load_triangle_data()   triangle.txt  -> list of rows of ints
#   problem_manager.load_cipher_data()     cipher.txt    -> list of ints
#   problem_manager.load_keylog_data()     keylog.txt    -> list of strings
#   problem_manager.load_roman_data()      roman.txt     -> list of strings
#   problem_manager.load_base_exp_data()   base_exp.txt  -> list of (base, exponent)
#   problem_manager.load_sudoku_data()     sudoku.txt    -> list of 9x9 grids
#
# Any file named after its problem number (for example data/0102_triangles.txt,
# added from the Data Files tab):
#   problem_manager.load_data(102)                       -> list of lines


def load_rows(problem, separator=","):
    """Return a numbered data file as rows of ints, skipping blank lines."""
    rows = []
    for line in problem_manager.load_data(problem):
        if line.strip():
            rows.append([int(x) for x in line.split(separator)])
    return rows


def solve():
    words = problem_manager.load_words_data()
    return len(words)
